_doc: Canonical revisit-gate policy. Owner: src/volpred/research/revisit_gate.py. Experiment scripts MUST import gate_for_pipeline() instead of hardcoding thresholds. Replaces the copy-pasted REVISIT_GATE_TOTAL_DAYS=200 / REVISIT_GATE_TEST_DAYS=50 pair that K1325's public article (mile_3445217e) admitted was too loose to ever decide anything.

policy._target_abs_t_why: research_program.md Harvey bar: |t| > 3 before a forecasting verdict is publishable.
policy._min_test_days_floor_why: Below ~60 test days the HAC/Harvey small-sample corrections in dm_hln are themselves unreliable, so a large |t| there is a reason to distrust the statistic rather than to act on it.
policy._max_wait_trading_days_why: ~2 years. Past that, the stationary-effect assumption behind the sqrt(n) extrapolation is not credible (index composition, microstructure, regime drift), so 'revisit later' stops being a plan and the design has to change instead.

tw50_5min_har_rv.description: 0050.TW 5-min realized-variance HAR-RV vs Random Walk checkpoint chain: K1307 -> K1318 -> K1322 -> K1324 -> K1325.

supersedes._why: Four scripts in one chain carried three different hardcoded thresholds, none derived. At n_test = 50 the implied DM-HLN |t| is ~1.47 against a |t| > 3 bar, so the old gate could only ever reproduce the same inconclusive verdict. Public commitment: article mile_3445217e (K1325 general).

split._test_fraction_why: The chain holds out the last 30% of post-warm-up rows (K1325: 60 HAR rows -> 42 train / 18 test).
split._warmup_days_why: HAR's 22-day monthly lag consumes the first 22 raw days before the first usable feature row.
